mentions.claim_text: He sees fires in buildings and major skyscrapers on fire, then sees Israel and a surprise attack, with a circle and fires inside the circle concerning Israel.
mentions.quote: I see major skyscrapers on fires. And I saw Israel and I see
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise attack on Israel alongside skyscraper fires.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a planned attack against New York from the barges, sees boats in the rivers, and that Israel and America are on the same time frame, calling it a D-Day.
mentions.quote: there's a planned attack against New York from the barges
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on New York launched from river barges.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Cuba and Miami and the southernmost point at Key West, notes that people would call it suicide, and sees drones on boats.
mentions.quote: I see drones. I see drones on boats
mentions.falsify_match: A drone attack on Florida launched from boats out of Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the 250th anniversary across the nation and over Hawaii, the hotels and the malls in Honolulu, and says he sees those three men again in Honolulu.
mentions.quote: I see those three men again, Braden, in Honolulu
mentions.falsify_match: An attack at a Honolulu hotel or mall.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking largely in tongues he names America's pastimes, a Boston ballpark, and calls for prayer at midnight concerning the banks.
mentions.quote: Pray in the midnight. Concerning the banks
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at a named ballpark or a bank event.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is to control Europe and to control Italy, sees the Vatican and Rome, and tells them to watch the jet streams concerning these volcanoes, calling them unusual.
mentions.quote: Watch the jet streams concerning these volcanoes
mentions.falsify_match: Volcanic ash carried on the jet stream disrupts Europe.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the churches against a surprise attack, and says he sees terrorist attacks in Canada and Toronto and assignments in Toronto.
mentions.quote: I see terrorist attacks in Canada in Toronto
mentions.falsify_match: A terrorist attack in Toronto.

mentions.claim_text: He sees arsonists over churches and places of worship, churches burning in Canada, arsonists in Toronto Catholic churches, and says these are Muslim men burning Christian places of worship.
mentions.quote: these are Muslim men to burn Christian places of worship
mentions.falsify_match: Church arson in Canada attributed to Muslim perpetrators.
mentions.falsify_miss: Arson continues from other causes. Canadian church fires since 2021 have mostly been linked to residential school anger, not Islamist actors.

mentions.claim_text: He says the same assignment is coming to Europe, that he sees it burning like Notre Dame, and that they will try to burn the churches across the land.
mentions.quote: I see it burning like Notre Dame
mentions.falsify_match: A cathedral fire on the Notre Dame scale in Europe.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are poking the giant and that he hears an awakening of a giant across the land, which will happen across Europe and in England, with national monuments and treasures burned.
mentions.quote: national monuments, national treasures like trying to burn them
mentions.falsify_match: Attacks on national monuments in Britain and Europe.

mentions.claim_text: He calls every plot and plan across the land to nothing, declares they will not burn our churches in Canada or Europe, and says he sees a poking of the bear.
mentions.quote: You'll not burn our churches. Across Canada
mentions.falsify_match: Church arson rates fall.
mentions.falsify_miss: They rise. He claims both that the fires are coming and that they will not happen.

mentions.claim_text: He declares they will not be able to rig the election, calls for a fair election in California for a named candidate, and calls fair elections in Minnesota and California.
mentions.quote: They will not be able to rig the election
mentions.falsify_match: No documented fraud in those races.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over America's elections and over the elections coming in Colombia and Brazil, saying they will put the list up.
mentions.quote: over your elections, Colombia, and Brazil
mentions.falsify_match: Conservative wins in those elections.

mentions.claim_text: He says the relationship with God should be first, and that the Lord said he saw fires across the country and fires in Europe with the churches being burned.
mentions.quote: I saw fires across the country. Fires in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of church fires in both regions.
mentions.falsify_miss: Rates stay at their long term level.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is about the riots and that he sees buildings burning in New York again worse than in Paris, and mentions the Middle East.
mentions.quote: I see buildings burning in New York again. Worse than in Paris
mentions.falsify_match: New York rioting exceeding the French unrest.

mentions.claim_text: He says another and bigger meteor is coming that will be very bright and will show up over New York, and sees the One World Trade building.
mentions.quote: Another meteor is coming. It will show up over New York
mentions.falsify_match: A bright bolide visible over New York.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is a representation that a great change and revival are coming to California, that he saw revival coming to Hollywood, and that the shaking he saw was not a devastating earthquake like the one at the false temples.
mentions.quote: this was not a devastating earthquake like I saw in these false temples
mentions.falsify_match: A moderate Californian earthquake followed by a religious movement.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. He lowers the bar himself by saying it is not the devastating one.

mentions.claim_text: He describes figs on the fig tree that were not small but almost the size of avocados or mangoes, and beautiful all over the tree.
mentions.quote: they look like mangoes. That's how big these figs were
mentions.falsify_match: The fig tree sign resolves to a datable event.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is the time of the great awakening and the greatest harvest of souls the world has ever seen is about to happen, that they are getting in position to reap it, and that the Lord said he is going to shake.
mentions.quote: the greatest harvest of souls this world has ever seen before is about to happen
mentions.falsify_match: Mass conversions on an unprecedented scale.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw shakings in Portland, Oregon that would be symbolic of a change, that revival is coming to the Hollywood Hills, and that he does not know how far Hollywood is from Malibu and is not familiar with it.
mentions.quote: I don't know how far Hollywood is from Malibu
mentions.falsify_match: Earthquakes at those places followed by a religious movement.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. He says himself he does not know the geography.

mentions.claim_text: He says whatever it is, it is a representation of his shaking, that a change and a revival are coming to California, and asks the audience to attach their faith with his.
mentions.quote: It's going to represent a change is coming to California
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised Californian revival.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that a magnitude 4.1 struck outside Las Vegas, mostly strike slip with an extensional component, the latest in a moving line of seismic activity from the Juan de Fuca plate down into Nevada, which is said to be primed for movement.
mentions.quote: a moving line of seismic activity from the Juan de Fuca down into Nevada
mentions.falsify_match: A major Nevada or Cascadia earthquake follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. The line of activity framing is from the post he is reading, not from him.

mentions.claim_text: He and his co-host discuss a man trying to bring a virus from Africa into the United States at Detroit to make people sick, unsure whether it was Ebola or mpox.
mentions.quote: He was trying to bring in a virus from another country into our country
mentions.falsify_match: A deliberate pathogen importation case is prosecuted.
mentions.falsify_miss: The reported case is a smuggling or customs matter rather than an attack.

mentions.claim_text: He begins on something widespread and a depopulation and is told not to touch it, that he has said enough today, and then that he must not forget the celebrities.
mentions.quote: He said you've said enough today
mentions.falsify_match: The withheld content later matches an event.
mentions.falsify_miss: It cannot be checked because he does not say it.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that a parasitic fly whose larvae feed only on the tissue of warm blooded animals has been detected in United States livestock in south Texas for the first time in decades.
mentions.quote: detected in US livestock in decades
mentions.falsify_match: A screwworm outbreak spreads through American livestock.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is contained. Screwworm had been moving north through Central America for two years before this, so a Texas detection was anticipated.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said there will be an attack on the oil refineries, and that he told them the United States will invade Cuba in the days ahead and bring in business, with rich Cuban business people rising up.
mentions.quote: United States will invade Cuba and they will bring in business
mentions.falsify_match: An American operation against Cuba followed by commercial opening.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a black swan event by the government rising up in Cuba and in France to destabilise the nation and bring forth a digital ID, and that France will push hard.
mentions.quote: I saw black swan event by the government rising up in Cuba in of France
mentions.falsify_match: A French destabilisation used to introduce digital identity.

mentions.claim_text: He points back to things shown six or seven months, a year and longer ago about Cuba and others, says there is so much happening because times are accelerating, and gives the glory to God.
mentions.quote: times are accelerating
mentions.falsify_match: Events continue to compound.

mentions.claim_text: He calls a named candidate to win Florida by a landslide and another to win Minnesota, and thanks God for Oklahoma, Arkansas and Texas with a red wave.
mentions.quote: in Florida, we call Byron to win it by a landslide
mentions.falsify_match: Landslide wins in Florida and Minnesota.

mentions.claim_text: He says they stand in Europe unmoved by the buildings burning and the rioting in France, and by the talk of voter ID and the disruption to planes, trains and automobiles.
mentions.quote: we're not moved by what we see as the buildings are burning
mentions.falsify_match: French unrest continues and spreads.

mentions.claim_text: He declares he is blessed in the field, coming in and going out, not moved by what he sees or feels but by what the word says, and argues from the sparrows and the lilies.
mentions.quote: I'm not moved by what I see. I'm not moved by what I feel
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a declaration.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says everything will be uncovered and everything is going to be all right, that he will not have it and will not do it, and that they are going to deflate it.
mentions.quote: Everything will be uncovered. Everything's going to be all right
mentions.falsify_match: A plan is exposed and collapses.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. No person or plan is named.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is organised and there is chatter, sees Chicago, New York, Boston and Washington, and hears multiple hundreds of millions of dollars behind it.
mentions.quote: There's chatter. I can see Chicago. I can see New York
mentions.falsify_match: Coordinated funded unrest across those four cities.

mentions.claim_text: He describes money, power, corruption and private jets dissuading people, and says the man has a fifty fifty chance if the church does not pray, with the revival starting well and corruption coming in through money laundering.
mentions.quote: He has a 50 50 shot if the church don't pray for him
mentions.falsify_match: A financial scandal inside the movement.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. A fifty fifty framing means either outcome fits.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told their heart is not for me and their nose is turned up before me, prays for the president to stay on the path of humility, and says he saw him in the valley of decision again over Israel and the war.
mentions.quote: Their heart is not for me, Brandon
mentions.falsify_match: A decisive presidential choice on Israel and the war.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was not the Olympics, that he sees in part and that adding to it is bad, and that he told everyone to pray because he saw it on fire with a major uprising about to happen in Paris.
mentions.quote: There's major uprising about to happen in Paris
mentions.falsify_match: Major rioting in Paris.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He corrects his own earlier reading that it was the Olympics.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether the audience remembers this, says they will continue to pray for Europe and that a major revival and a major shaking are about to take place there.
mentions.quote: A major revival is about to take place
mentions.falsify_match: A European revival.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why they are destroying things, is told there are gangs involved, and says an uprising of civil unrest is obviously happening around the world with major protests on the fourteenth.
mentions.quote: an uprising of civil unrest is happening obviously around the world
mentions.falsify_match: Large scale unrest at the protests on the fourteenth.

mentions.claim_text: He is shown an Iranian drone hitting an airport in Kuwait that day, and remarks that he thought they were out of materiel and clearly they are not.
mentions.quote: I thought they were out of stuff. They're obviously not
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian drone attacks on Gulf states continue.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a red wave concerning the midterms and revival breaking out in California, that the Lord said to pray for this and it would be shock and awe, and that the night before he saw a beautiful blanket coming up over Minnesota.
mentions.quote: It would be a shock and awe
mentions.falsify_match: A Republican sweep in the midterms with a Californian revival.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the forked tongue licking the dirt on the way to the White House, is told the reports say governor, and says that is great, and that a named candidate winning a mayoralty would be fantastic.
mentions.quote: with his forked tongue licking the dirt as he goes
mentions.falsify_match: Newsom moves toward a presidential run.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not. He accepts the correction that the reports are about a governorship.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was praying for Ukraine and for peace and a diffusing of things, and that he saw the Ukrainian president being taken out by an assassin.
mentions.quote: I saw Zelensky being taken out by an assassin
mentions.falsify_match: Zelensky is assassinated.

mentions.claim_text: He says named ministers are being stationed in Israel for a reason and going on a tour, and that he sees a prayer gathering over the people going there.
mentions.quote: He is stationing Billy and them in Israel for a reason
mentions.falsify_match: Something significant occurs in Israel during the tour.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a prayer covering going in with the group in Israel, and that he sees a surprise attack trying to come against Israel in the night, with a covering of prayer over it.
mentions.quote: I see a surprise attack trying to come against Israel in the night
mentions.falsify_match: A night attack on Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Prayer covering means a non event is credited to intercession.

mentions.claim_text: He says acceleration is to come and that as they look toward Israel they should look at the fig tree, which he sees ripe with figs ready to be picked.
mentions.quote: I see a fig tree that is ripe
mentions.falsify_match: A datable event follows the fig tree sign.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be signs and wonders and shaking in the earth's crust and in the land, strategic shakings, and a shaking in Malibu to say that a change is coming.
mentions.quote: THERE'LL BE A SHAKING IN MALIBU TO TELL you that there's a change coming
mentions.falsify_match: An earthquake at Malibu.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the shaking in Malibu as a sign of a change, calls it a changing of the tide and a cultivation of new water, and says a great revival will be seen across all California.
mentions.quote: A SHAKING A SIGN OF A CHANGE. It's a changing of a tide
mentions.falsify_match: A Malibu earthquake followed by a Californian revival.

mentions.claim_text: He says the old false temples come to the ground as a sign that he is shaking false religion, the church, Israel and America, repeating that he is going to shake it and many will see.
mentions.quote: this will be a sign that I'm shaking false religion
mentions.falsify_match: Ancient temples destroyed by earthquakes.

mentions.claim_text: He says an escalation of things would try to take place and that he then saw the island completely engulfed with fire for the oil, and says he does not know whether the reported American self-defence strikes are it.
mentions.quote: I saw the island completely engulfed with fire for the oil
mentions.falsify_match: An island oil terminal set alight.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. He asks whether this is it rather than asserting it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has prayed over this a lot and that there are certain things he keeps his mouth shut about, and turns to Cuba and the secretary of state.
mentions.quote: There's certain things I just keep my mouth shut
mentions.falsify_match: The withheld content later matches an event.
mentions.falsify_miss: It cannot be checked because he does not say it.

mentions.claim_text: He restates the David and Saul comparison with the vice president slaying thousands, says the secretary of state will rise as a leader people like, and that a major revival is coming to Cuba with three major wells of revival.
mentions.quote: Three major wells of revival coming out of Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: Three prominent Cuban churches emerge and Rubio rises.

mentions.claim_text: He is shown footage of robots and asks whether it is Boston, and is told it is a named robotics company.
mentions.quote: we got robots looking at stuff
mentions.falsify_match: Robotic systems are deployed in the role he has described.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a man with a shotgun was stopped and gives glory to God, then says he saw trains full of chemicals coming out of the Mississippi and Alabama area.
mentions.quote: I saw trains full of chemicals coming out of Mississippi, Alabama
mentions.falsify_match: A chemical train incident in those states.

mentions.claim_text: He says they would try to place a device on the railroad to derail a train by explosive as it went by, and that he saw big tanks like propane tanks moving around America.
mentions.quote: a device on the railroad to try to derail it by an explosive
mentions.falsify_match: A deliberate derailment using an explosive device.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that police are investigating videos of men mysteriously emerging from New York City sewers, and jokes about it.
mentions.quote: videos of men mysteriously emerging from New York City sewers
mentions.falsify_match: The sewer activity is tied to a plot.
